messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Elevated PCIe AER / Xid events observed on rack42 nodes (rack42-01..rack42-08). Degraded p99 latency on infer queue. Alert ID: AER-2026-0423

kai: seeing the same in the qps dashboards, p99 tokens up ~2.3x since 03:10 UTC.

lenora: grafana snapshot -> https://grafana.internal/rack42/aer-spike-2026 (logs + histograms). Xid count spikes line up with NVLink link flaps.

matt: pulled dmesg from rack42-05, snippet:
```
[03:11:02] pcieport 0000:01:00.0: AER: Corrected error, device id 10de:1db6
[03:11:02] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:01:00): 79, GPU reports: FER
[03:11:05] nvlink0: link 2 down
[03:11:05] nvlink0: link 2 up
[03:11:10] AER: Multiple reset requests suppressed by firmware
```

kai: "suppressed by firmware" is interesting — sounds like BIOS/MC firmware is throttling AER. Could be masking resets and leaving GPU in degraded perf mode.

infra-ash: correct, we've hit vendor notes on that. Some firmware versions suppress automatic AER micro resets to avoid cascades, but that can leave ECC/FER state uncleared.

sre-jen: what's the immediate plan? Do we need to start draining?

matt: recommend controlled drain of rack42-05 and rack42-06 first (highest error rates). Put them in maintenance, move workloads to rack40/41.

oncall-dana: capacity hit will be ~6% cluster-wide during drain window. ops: can we shift dedicated reserved pools to other racks?

kai: yes, we can reprovision routing rules for the next 30m window. I'll kick off migration once drain list confirmed.

lenora: quick grep across hosts shows repeated pattern: "AER: Corrected error" every ~3-10s during spike. Xid codes mostly 79/31.

matt: tried soft reset via nvidia-smi on rack42-05 but driver returns "reset suppressed". Kernel logs show vendor suppression flag.

ops-bot: Incident bot: Created incident INC-6314, assigned -> infra-ash, severity -> high, follow-up ticket -> PRT-12345.

infra-ash: action items I propose:
- 1) Immediate: cordon/drain rack42-05,42-06. Move live slots to rack40/41. (30min) :wrench:
- 2) Short term: roll BIOS/MC firmware to vendor-recommended build that re-enables AER resets (patch from vendor). (2-3h maintenance)
- 3) Long term: schedule full riser/slot swap for rack42 if firmware doesn't resolve. (RMA window)

sre-jen: agree. add a temporary NVLink rate limiter in runtime to avoid tight link flapping causing recovery storms? Could help during migration.

kai: I can deploy a per-host throttle flag: inference.runtime.nvlink_error_backoff=200ms. Low risk, quick revert.

matt: collecting per-GPU metrics for ticket: nvidia-smi --query-gpu=timestamp,index,name,memory.total,utilization.gpu,retired_pages,curr_ecc_errors --format=csv -l 1 > /tmp/rack42-ecc.csv

lenora: paste of quick CSV tail:
```
timestamp, index, name, memory.total, utilization.gpu, retired_pages, curr_ecc_errors
2026-04-23T03:11:02, 5, A100-80GB, 81136 MiB, 92 %, 0, 14
2026-04-23T03:11:05, 6, A100-80GB, 81136 MiB, 89 %, 0, 18
```

infra-ash: 14/18 corrected ECC counts are high. Not yet hitting retired_pages but trending. Good to evacuate.

oncall-dana: scheduling note: can we avoid customer-impacting retrains between 03:30-05:00 UTC? Also ping support that dedicated customers might see 5-10% perf variance.

kai: I'm starting the drain now for rack42-05. Moving inference routing for pool-id: inference-prod-r42 -> inference-prod-alt-2.

ops-bot: automations: started drain playbook DRN-204, ETA for empty = ~22 minutes.

matt: while draining, I'll open SSH session to vendor console to pull MC logs and request firmware artifact. If vendor-supplied firmware available, we should bench it on rack40 single node first.

lenora: note to self: correlate with cooling telemetry — rack42 inlet temp rose ~1.8C during spike; maybe thermal transients trigger link retrain anomalies.

infra-ash: agreed, but correlation != causation. We'll do firmware patch + thermal floor check.

kai: drain finished for rack42-05. Jobs successfully routed. Rack42-06 drain starting.

sre-jen: after both drains, run validation suite: perf P50/P95/P99 compare to baseline, and run synthetic nvlink_stress 2m.

matt: created vendor SR# SR-9987 to request MC firmware that disables the suppression flag and adds more granular AER handling. Vendor ETA 4h. SR attached to PRT-12345.

oncall-dana: creating customer comms draft for dedicated customers who might be affected.

kai: temporary mitigations in place: throttle + draining impacted nodes. If vendor patch doesn't arrive in 4h, we'll schedule riser replacement for rack42 in next maintenance window.

lenora: will follow up with longer-term telemetry alert: add rule to detect "AER corrected error rate > 5/s per GPU for 1m" and trigger infra paging.

ops-bot: Incident INC-6314 updated: status -> mitigation in progress.

matt: final note: tie PRT-12345 to cluster-health dashboard so we auto-annotate graph when SR updates.

kai: thanks team. I'll post postmortem ops notes after patch and RMA outcomes. :thumbsup:
